#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""Original loaded-result predicates with the exact new saved-capsule inventory."""
import ast,hashlib,json,os
import cdr_current_eight_drain_loaded_admission as a

ORIGINAL="scripts/cloud_cdr_v59_loaded_stage.py"
ORIGINAL_SHA="8a73b595e6e84c0e92020edcc62d618c07463b0819f20096f2d6122763e9107b"
OLD_INVENTORY="dict(files=5549,all_hashes_unchanged=True)"
NEW_INVENTORY="dict(files="+str(a.NATIVE_MEMBERS)+",all_hashes_unchanged=True,exact_inventory=True)"
PREPARATION_PASS="PASS_PD500_LOADED_PREPARATION_AND13_BINDING_CONTROLS_NO_TRANSIENT"
CASE_PASS="PASS_WHOLE_MIM_PD500_LOADED_SCREEN_NOT_CLOSED_LOOP_OR_PHY_SIGNOFF"

def validator():
    path=a.regular(a.ROOT,ORIGINAL)
    a.require(a.sha(path)==ORIGINAL_SHA,"Original loaded stage changed")
    text=path.read_text()
    nodes=[n for n in ast.parse(text).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)and n.name=="validate_result"]
    a.require(len(nodes)==1,"Original loaded result validator missing")
    original=ast.get_source_segment(text,nodes[0])
    a.require(original.count(OLD_INVENTORY)==1,"Original loaded inventory predicate changed")
    derived=original.replace(OLD_INVENTORY,NEW_INVENTORY)
    a.require(derived.count(NEW_INVENTORY)==1 and derived.replace(NEW_INVENTORY,OLD_INVENTORY)==original,
      "Loaded validator inventory derivation is not exact")
    scope={"os":os}
    exec(compile(derived,str(path)+"::current"+str(a.NATIVE_MEMBERS),"exec"),scope)
    return scope["validate_result"],{
      "original_source":ORIGINAL,"original_source_sha256":ORIGINAL_SHA,
      "original_function_sha256":hashlib.sha256(original.encode()).hexdigest(),
      "derived_function_sha256":hashlib.sha256(derived.encode()).hexdigest(),
      "only_substitution":{"before":OLD_INVENTORY,"after":NEW_INVENTORY}}

def validate(report,case,prepare,code,prepared=None):
    a.require(case in a.CASES and type(prepare)is bool and(not prepare or case=="nominal_early"),
      "Invalid original loaded case mode")
    original,derivation=validator();original(report,case,prepare,code)
    a.require(report["terminal_finalization_complete"]is True and report["terminal_inventory_complete"]is True
      and not report["terminal_errors"],"Loaded worker terminal evidence incomplete")
    actions=report["terminal_actions"]
    a.require([x["action"]for x in actions]==["protected_sources","complete_saved_inputs",
      "preserve_preexisting_atomic_fragment","complete_output_inventory"]and all(x["completed"]is True for x in actions),
      "Loaded worker terminal action set changed")
    a.require(report["terminal_save_attempted"]is True and report["active_primary_exception_before_terminal"]is None,
      "Loaded worker has a terminal primary failure")
    d=a.source_guard();full=a.full_map(d)
    remote=a.validate_live(d["run.json"],d["jobs.json"],d["release.json"],d["tag-ref.json"],d)
    proof=report["composition_source"]
    expected={k:v for k,v in a.composition_proof(d,None,remote).items()if k!="full_archive"}
    a.exact({k:v for k,v in proof.items()if k!="full_archive"},expected,
      "Loaded current width/graph/RC provenance changed")
    # The raw result is a capsule member; the separately authenticated direct
    # summary adds publication-driver.log and cannot substitute for that member.
    a.require(a.RAW_SHA!=a.SUMMARY_SHA and full["result.json"]==a.RAW_SHA
      and full[a.MODEL_MEMBER]==a.MODEL_SHA and full[a.PLANES_MEMBER]==a.PLANES_SHA,
      "Loaded exact raw result/model/planes changed")
    archive=proof["full_archive"]
    a.require(type(archive["regular_members"])is int and archive["regular_members"]==a.NATIVE_MEMBERS
      and archive["full_inventory_verified"]is True,"Loaded complete archive proof changed")
    a.exact({name:row["sha256"]for name,row in archive["complete_member_hashes"].items()},full,
      "Loaded complete archive proof changed")
    plane=report["native_plane_source"]
    a.exact(plane,a.plane_proof(d),
      "Loaded current plane/model binding changed")
    interface=d["direct/composition.json"]["interface"]
    external={name:"0"if name in ("avss","sub","wire_cref")else name for name in interface}
    a.require(report["binding"]["interface"]==external and report["binding"]["ports"]==[external[name]for name in interface],
      "Loaded current ordered interface changed")
    if not prepare:
        a.require(type(prepared)is dict,"Same-run preparation report required")
        validate(prepared,"nominal_early",True,0)
        a.require(prepared["composition_source"]["summary_sha256"]==proof["summary_sha256"]
          and prepared["composition_source"]["stage_sha256"]==proof["stage_sha256"]
          and prepared["composition_source"]["raw_result_sha256"]==proof["raw_result_sha256"]
          and prepared["native_plane_source"]==plane,"Preparation/current composition differs")
        a.require(report["vectors"]==prepared["vectors"]and report["vector_census"]==prepared["vector_census"],
          "Original acquired preparation vector census changed")
        a.require(report["native_save_commands"]==prepared["native_save_commands"],"Original native save command order changed")
    return {"original_validator_derivation":derivation,"all_original_electrical_predicates_retained":True,
      "complete_current_members":a.NATIVE_MEMBERS,"acquired_vectors":report["vector_census"],
      "original_status":report["status"],"case":case,"preparation_only":prepare,
      "fresh_RC_run":a.RUN,"fresh_RC_source":a.HEAD,"raw_result_sha256":a.RAW_SHA,
      "publication_summary_sha256":a.SUMMARY_SHA,"current_width_run":a.PHYSICAL_RUN,"current_graph_run":a.GRAPH_RUN,"accepted":False,"full_phy_accepted":False}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Hasan Melih Akbulut
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""Loaded whole PD500 native MIM-aware transient; not a recovered-clock loop.

Preserves all actual freshly audited R/C records and 500 native devices. Test loads are 150fF
at each sampler data-pair collector and 50fF at external comparator ports.
The collector reference is explicitly bound through native LVS/plane identities,
not an ideal alias of the distributed macro output net. External 8GHz clock.
"""
import argparse,copy,hashlib,json,os,re,shutil,subprocess,traceback
from collections import Counter
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import cloud_tx_stream as stream
from run_cloud_tx_mux4 import native_save_commands
import cloud_cdr_pd_vi as legacy
import cloud_cdr_xor as primitive
import cloud_pll_pump_current as pump
import compare_cloud_routed_endpoints as reports
import cdr_current_eight_drain_loaded_admission as current_inputs
import cdr_v59_tail_loaded_terminal as loaded_terminal
import build_pcie_local_vco_hybrid_v6 as parser
from cloud_vbic_tree32_backend import backend_readback,readback_controls
from route_cloud_newer_postcts import fetch,sha
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
UI=legacy.UI;START=legacy.START;STOP=legacy.STOP;STEP=legacy.STEP
MODEL='nssoc_cdr_pd500_resistor_mim_wire_v59'
CASES=['nominal_early','nominal_late','hot_early','hot_late','cold_early','cold_late','constant_zero','constant_one','clock_stopped','vi_bias_off']
BIASES=['ira','irb','irc','ird','irx','iry','ibda','ibdc','ibs0','ibs1']

def bind_native(text,contract,planes):
    rows=parser.statements(text);interface=contract['interface']
    assert rows[0]==['.subckt',MODEL,*interface]and rows[-1]==['.ends',MODEL]
    assert len(interface)==len(set(interface))==26
    assert set(interface)==set(['dp','dn','cp','cn','xp','xn','yp','yn','avdd','avss','sub','wire_cref','vip','vin','irvx','irvy',*BIASES])
    external={p:'0'if p in ('avss','sub','wire_cref')else p for p in interface}
    def node(n):return external[n]if n in external else 'xpd.'+n.lower()
    cards={r[0].lower():r for r in rows[1:-1]};assert len(cards)==len(rows)-2
    native={d['instance'].lower():d for d in contract['device_records']};assert len(native)==500 and contract['counts']['devices']==500
    assert {n for n in cards if n.startswith('x')}==set(native)
    assert Counter(r[0][0]for r in rows[1:-1])==dict(X=500,R=contract['counts']['R'],C=contract['counts']['C'])
    groups={kind:{}for kind in ('npn13g2','sg13_lv_nmos','rppd','cap_cmim','ptap1')}
    logical={}
    for plane in planes['anchors']:
        pair=(plane['native_cluster'],plane['native_name'])
        assert logical.setdefault(plane['logical_net'],pair)==pair
    assert len(logical)==51
    witnesses={};native_nodes={}
    for name,d in native.items():
        terms=d['terminals'];f=cards[name];n=len(terms)
        assert f[1:n+1]==[t['node']for t in terms]and f[n+1]==d['model']
        params=dict(x.split('=')for x in f[n+2:]);assert len(params)==len(f[n+2:])and params==d['parameters']
        assert len({t['terminal']for t in terms})==n
        native_nodes[name]={t['terminal']:t['native_net']for t in terms}
        for t in terms:
            if t['native_net']in {v[1]for v in logical.values()}:
                assert (t['native_cluster'],t['native_net'])in logical.values()
        dev=dict(nodes=[node(t['node'])for t in terms],parameters=params,native_id=d['native_id'])
        if d['model']=='npn13g2':
            assert [t['terminal']for t in terms]==['C','B','E','S']
            assert set(params)=={'nx','we','le'}
            assert parser.number(params['we'])==Decimal('0.07e-6')and parser.number(params['le'])==Decimal('0.9e-6')
            nx=parser.number(params['nx']);assert nx==int(nx)and nx>0;dev['nx']=int(nx)
        if d['model']=='sg13_lv_nmos':
            assert [t['terminal']for t in terms]==['D','G','S','B']
            assert set(params)=={'w','l','as','ad','ps','pd','rfmode','ng','m'}
            assert parser.number(params['w'])in (Decimal('8e-6'),Decimal('32e-6'),Decimal('36e-6'),Decimal('53.335e-6'),Decimal('64e-6')) and parser.number(params['l'])==Decimal('.3e-6')
            assert parser.number(params['rfmode'])==0 and parser.number(params['ng'])==parser.number(params['m'])==1
            assert all(parser.number(params[k])>0 for k in ('as','ad','ps','pd'))
        groups[d['model']]['xpd.'+name]=dev
    assert {k:len(v)for k,v in groups.items()}==dict(npn13g2=124,sg13_lv_nmos=50,rppd=98,cap_cmim=7,ptap1=221)
    hbts=groups['npn13g2'];aliases={};sampler_points={}
    def candidates(net,terminal='C'):
        cluster,native_net=logical[net]
        return [(name,d)for name,d in native.items()if d['model']=='npn13g2'and any(t['terminal']==terminal and t['native_cluster']==cluster and t['native_net']==native_net for t in d['terminals'])]
    # Choose the data-pair collector, not the cross-coupled hold-pair collector.
    # Both remain in the distributed network; no electrical aliases are inserted.
    for tag in 'abcd':
        for leg,other in [('p','n'),('n','p')]:
            net=tag+'q'+leg;opposite=logical[tag+'q'+other][1]
            choices=[(name,d)for name,d in candidates(net)if native_nodes[name]['B']!=opposite]
            assert len(candidates(net))==2 and len(choices)==1,(net,choices)
            name,d=choices[0];point=node(next(t['node']for t in d['terminals']if t['terminal']=='C'))
            aliases['xpd.'+net]=point;sampler_points[net]=point
            witnesses[net]=dict(device=name,terminal='C',native_cluster=logical[net][0],native_net=logical[net][1],probe=point,load_f=150e-15,selection='data-pair collector; hold-pair B is opposite output')
    for net in ('adp','adn','cdp','cdn','s0p','s0n','s1p','s1n'):
        choices=candidates(net);assert len(choices)==1
        name,d=choices[0];aliases['xpd.'+net]=node(next(t['node']for t in d['terminals']if t['terminal']=='C'))
    tails=[];mos_tails=[];mos_tail_groups={}
    assert Counter(parser.number(d['parameters']['w'])for d in groups['sg13_lv_nmos'].values())=={Decimal('8e-6'):8,Decimal('32e-6'):2,Decimal('36e-6'):32,Decimal('53.335e-6'):4,Decimal('64e-6'):4}
    for bias in ('ira','irb','irc','ird','irx','iry','ibs0','ibs1'):
        found=['xpd.'+name for name,d in native.items()if d['model']=='sg13_lv_nmos'and native_nodes[name]['G']==bias and native_nodes[name]['S']=='avss'and native_nodes[name]['D']!=bias]
        sampler=bias in ('ira','irb','irc','ird')
        gain_sampler=bias in ('irc','ird')
        assert len(found)==(10 if gain_sampler else 8 if sampler else 1 if bias.startswith('ibs')else 2)
        by_drain={}
        for name in found:
            drain=native_nodes[name[4:]]['D']
            # Only new sampler four-way tails replace one old device.
            # Existing XOR devices share a drain but retain INDIVIDUAL gates.
            key=drain if sampler else drain+':'+name
            by_drain.setdefault(key,[]).append(name)
        assert len(by_drain)==(3 if gain_sampler else 1 if bias.startswith('ibs')else 2)
        for drain,names in by_drain.items():
            widths=Counter(parser.number(groups['sg13_lv_nmos'][n]['parameters']['w'])for n in names)
            if sampler:
                assert widths=={Decimal('36e-6'):4}or(gain_sampler and widths=={Decimal('53.335e-6'):2})
            else:assert len(names)==1
            mos_tail_groups[bias+':'+drain]=names
        if gain_sampler:
            assert Counter(tuple(sorted(parser.number(groups['sg13_lv_nmos'][n]['parameters']['w'])for n in names))for names in by_drain.values())=={(Decimal('36e-6'),)*4:2,(Decimal('53.335e-6'),)*2:1}
        mos_tails+=found
    for bias in ('ibda','ibdc'):
        found=['xpd.'+name for name,d in native.items()if d['model']=='npn13g2'and native_nodes[name]['B']==bias and native_nodes[name]['E']=='avss'and native_nodes[name]['C']!=bias]
        assert len(found)==1;tails+=found
    assert len(tails)==2 and len(mos_tails)==42 and len(mos_tail_groups)==16
    vi={}
    for role,base,collector in [('xxp','xp','vin'),('xxn','xn','vip'),('xyp','yp','vip'),('xyn','yn','vin')]:
        found=['xpd.'+name for name,d in native.items()if d['model']=='npn13g2'and native_nodes[name]['B']==base and native_nodes[name]['C']==collector]
        assert len(found)==1;vi[role]=found[0]
    for role,bias in [('xtx','irvx'),('xty','irvy')]:
        found=['xpd.'+name for name,d in native.items()if d['model']=='npn13g2'and native_nodes[name]['B']==bias and native_nodes[name]['E']=='avss'and native_nodes[name]['C']!=bias]
        assert len(found)==1;vi[role]=found[0]
    for a,b,tail in [('xxp','xxn','xtx'),('xyp','xyn','xty')]:
        assert native_nodes[vi[a][4:]]['E']==native_nodes[vi[b][4:]]['E']==native_nodes[vi[tail][4:]]['C']
    return dict(groups=groups,ports=[external[p]for p in interface],interface=external,aliases=aliases,sampler_points=sampler_points,probe_witnesses=witnesses,tail_names=tails,mos_tail_names=mos_tails,mos_tail_groups=mos_tail_groups,vi_names=vi)

def binding_controls(text,contract,planes):
    good=bind_native(text,contract,planes);rejected=[]
    # Equivalent physical unit spellings accepted; actual dimensions stay exact.
    equivalent=text.replace('we=0.070u','we=70n').replace('le=0.900u','le=900n')
    c=copy.deepcopy(contract)
    for d in c['device_records']:
        if d['model']=='npn13g2':d['parameters'].update(we='70n',le='900n')
    assert bind_native(equivalent,c,planes)['sampler_points']==good['sampler_points']
    for case in ('missing_contact','wrong_hbt_width','wrong_mim_width','swapped_collector_base','swapped_sample_plane','wrong_vi_polarity','wrong_public_port'):
        rows=parser.statements(text);p=copy.deepcopy(planes)
        if case=='swapped_sample_plane':
            a=next(a for a in p['anchors']if a['logical_net']=='aqp')
            other=next(a for a in p['anchors']if a['logical_net']=='aqn')
            assert (a['native_cluster'],a['native_name'])!=(other['native_cluster'],other['native_name'])
            a['native_cluster'],a['native_name']=other['native_cluster'],other['native_name']
        elif case=='wrong_public_port':rows[0][2],rows[0][3]=rows[0][3],rows[0][2]
        else:
            model='ptap1'if case=='missing_contact'else'cap_cmim'if case=='wrong_mim_width'else'npn13g2'
            i=next(i for i,r in enumerate(rows)if model in r)
            if case=='missing_contact':del rows[i]
            elif case in ('swapped_collector_base','wrong_vi_polarity'):
                if case=='wrong_vi_polarity':i=next(i for i,r in enumerate(rows)if r[0].lower()==good['vi_names']['xxp'][4:])
                rows[i][1],rows[i][2]=rows[i][2],rows[i][1]
            else:
                key='w='if case=='wrong_mim_width'else'we=';j=next(j for j,x in enumerate(rows[i])if x.startswith(key));rows[i][j]=key+'999u'
        altered='\n'.join(' '.join(r)for r in rows)+'\n'
        try:bind_native(altered,contract,p)
        except (AssertionError,ValueError,KeyError):rejected.append(case)
        else:raise AssertionError('Accepted '+case)
    assert len(rejected)==7
    for case in ('missing_mos','wrong_mos_width','swapped_mos_gate_source','mos_body_short'):
        rows=parser.statements(text);i=next(i for i,r in enumerate(rows)if 'sg13_lv_nmos'in r)
        if case=='missing_mos':del rows[i]
        elif case=='wrong_mos_width':
            j=next(j for j,x in enumerate(rows[i])if x.startswith('w='));rows[i][j]='w=999u'
        elif case=='swapped_mos_gate_source':
            assert rows[i][2]!=rows[i][3];rows[i][2],rows[i][3]=rows[i][3],rows[i][2]
        else:
            assert rows[i][4]!=rows[i][3];rows[i][4]=rows[i][3]
        altered='\n'.join(' '.join(r)for r in rows)+'\n'
        try:bind_native(altered,contract,planes)
        except (AssertionError,ValueError,KeyError):rejected.append(case)
        else:raise AssertionError('Accepted '+case)
    assert len(rejected)==11
    gain=next(d for d in contract['device_records']if d['model']=='sg13_lv_nmos'and parser.number(d['parameters']['w'])==Decimal('53.335e-6'))
    for case,value in [('rounded_gain_mos_width','53.33u'),('old_gain_mos_width','36u')]:
        rows=parser.statements(text);row=next(row for row in rows if row[0]==gain['instance']);index=next(i for i,item in enumerate(row)if item.startswith('w='));row[index]='w='+value
        try:bind_native('\n'.join(' '.join(row)for row in rows)+'\n',contract,planes)
        except (AssertionError,ValueError,KeyError):rejected.append(case)
        else:raise AssertionError('Accepted '+case)
    assert len(rejected)==13
    return dict(equivalent_unit_spellings=2,rejected=rejected)

def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--case',choices=CASES,required=True);p.add_argument('--prepare-only',action='store_true');args=p.parse_args()
    assert os.environ.get('GITHUB_ACTIONS')=='true'
    assert UI==125e-12 and START==2e-9 and STOP==START+258*UI and STEP==.3125e-12
    method=json.loads((ROOT/'scripts/cdr-current-eight-drain-loaded-methods.json').read_text())
    assert all(sha(ROOT/name)==digest for name,digest in method['protected_sha256'].items())
    out=ROOT/('cloud-cdr-current-eight-drain-loaded-'+args.case);out.mkdir(exist_ok=False);reports.OUT=out
    corner='hot_low'if args.case.startswith('hot_')else'cold_high'if args.case.startswith('cold_')else'nominal'
    c=pump.CORNERS[corner];scale=c['scale'];offset=(-.15 if args.case.endswith('_early')else.15)*UI
    bits=([0]*256 if args.case=='constant_zero'else[1]*256 if args.case=='constant_one'else primitive.prbs(0x7f))
    constant=args.case.startswith('constant_');fault=args.case in ('clock_stopped','vi_bias_off')
    r=dict(status='RUNNING',source_head=os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'],case=args.case,accepted=False,full_phy_accepted=False,cdr_accepted=False,qualified_pex=False,closed_loop=False,
        scope='Actual PD500 complete native MIM-aware wire model:124HBT50LVNMOS98rppd7MIM221contacts; actual fresh MIM-aware R/C census from protected composition. External8GHz clock; original256bits and fixed phase/device gates. Added150fF at actual sampler data-pair collectors,50fF at external XOR outputs. No macro-port ideal alias, internal regenerated data or recovered clock. Native per-terminal voltages and actual VI collector currents. Requires full-loop/PVT/timestep/RF/body qualification.',data_offset_s=offset,corner=corner)
    def save():current_inputs.write(out/'result.json',r)
    save()
    try:
        assert sha(Path(legacy.__file__))=='a319d6ba9b7a26964e29355e76b34685fff7ff35199ca5a8dbdd4a62031d9c33'
        assert sha(ROOT/'scripts/cloud_cdr_xor.py')=='3ec870fa6a30d9f94038368d6b74c984c314c2d7248ecaab94c687867587fabe'
        r['readback_controls']=readback_controls()
        assert sha(Path(stream.__file__))=='2894eede2e5e087c23cadee9cec9dbdca359315a786cec0cabfe7f8da37449cb'
        assert sha(ROOT/'scripts/run_cloud_tx_mux4.py')=='bb7f5c5ef736dd54c5ed560424d97d248894f4aa6fa6119f1e95c5f5c3df4b52'
        tp=json.loads((ROOT/'docs/evidence/cdr-via-rich-stream-transport-pass-20261019.json').read_text())
        assert tp['report']['status']=='PASS_FULL_CDR_MODEL_ALL_VECTOR_3NS_STREAM_TRANSPORT_REQUIRES_FULL_LOADED_SCREEN'and tp['report']['sources_unchanged']
        assert tp['report']['stream_capture']['columns']==1108 and tp['report']['transport_comparison']['vectors']==1107
        r['transport_control_source']=dict(run=tp['run'],summary_sha256=tp['summary_sha256'],parts_sha256=tp['parts_sha256'])
        pinpath=ROOT/current_inputs.SUMMARY;pp=ROOT/current_inputs.STAGE
        prior,proof,model,contract,planes,plane_proof=current_inputs.restore(out,args.prepare_only)
        r['native_plane_source']=plane_proof

        r['composition_source']=proof;r['binding_controls']=binding_controls(model.read_text(),contract,planes)
        bound=bind_native(model.read_text(),contract,planes);devices=bound['groups']['npn13g2'];resistors=bound['groups']['rppd'];caps=bound['groups']['cap_cmim'];contacts=bound['groups']['ptap1'];ports=bound['ports'];biases=BIASES;mos=bound['groups']['sg13_lv_nmos']
        fetch(pump.BASE+'cloud-results-39029337682-1-pll-pump-current/pll-pump-current-39029337682-1.summary.json',primitive.SUMMARY,out/'models-pin.json')
        mp=json.loads((out/'models-pin.json').read_text());wanted=[n for n in mp['outputs']if n.startswith('source/model-sources/')]+['source-pin.json','source/runtime/patched-ngspice']
        old,mproof=reports.restore_report('pll-pump-current',39029337682,primitive.SUMMARY,primitive.PARTS,out/'source',wanted);assert old==mp;r['models_source']=mproof
        original=json.loads((out/'source/source-pin.json').read_text());assert sha(out/'source/source-pin.json')==pump.SUMMARY

def finalize(ctx,result,supervisor,heartbeat,previous,prepared):
    errors=[]

        attempt("owned_process_cleanup",cleanup)

    if heartbeat is not None:
        def join():

        attempt("join_heartbeat",join)

        def restore(sig=sig,handler=handler):signal.signal(sig,handler)
        attempt("restore_signal_"+str(int(sig)),restore)

        attempt("terminal_resource_sample",sample)

    attempt("original_native_case_qualification",lambda:qualify_native(ctx,result,prepared))

def validate_publication(ctx,result):
    a.require(result["source_head"]==os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"]
      and type(result["run_id"])is int and result["run_id"]==int(os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ID"])
      and type(result["run_attempt"])is int and result["run_attempt"]==1,"Loaded publication run/source changed")
    a.require(result["case"]==ctx["case"]and result["preparation_only"]is ctx["prepare"]
      and result["group"]==ctx["group"],"Loaded publication case changed")
    a.require(result["fresh_RC_run"]==a.RUN and result["original_physical_run"]==40369539200
      and result["original_physical_status"]=="FAIL_ADDITIVE_TAIL_WIRE_PHYSICAL"
      and result["original_physical_historical_only"]is True
      and (result["current_width_run"],result["current_width_source"])==(a.PHYSICAL_RUN,a.PHYSICAL_SOURCE)
      and (result["current_graph_run"],result["current_graph_source"])==(a.GRAPH_RUN,a.GRAPH_SOURCE)
      and result["original_eight_electrical_rejections_and_two_fault_detections_preserved"]is True,
      "Loaded publication prior evidence changed")
    a.require(all(result[k]is False for k in ("accepted","qualified_pex","full_phy_accepted","cdr_accepted",
      "physical_accepted","geometry_regenerated","native_extraction_executed","automatic_retry")),
      "Loaded publication acceptance scope changed")
    successful=result["status"]in (PREP_PASS,CASE_PASS)
    if successful:
        a.require(result["status"]==(PREP_PASS if ctx["prepare"]else CASE_PASS)
          and result["native_case_passed"]is True and result["terminal_finalization_complete"]is True
          and result["outer_terminal_finalization_complete"]is True and not result["outer_terminal_errors"]
          and not result["terminal_errors"]and result["native_evidence_preservation"]["complete"]is True,
          "Incomplete loaded case cannot publish as successful")
    else:a.require(result["status"].startswith(("FAIL_","RUNNING_")),"Unrecognized failed loaded status")
    a.require(result["outputs"]=={n:h for n,h in inventory(ctx["output"]).items()if n!="result.json"},
      "Loaded publication complete output inventory differs")
    return successful

def publish(ctx,result=None):
    return publication.publish(sys.modules[__name__],ctx,result)

def run_case(ctx,reservations):
    method=a.authorize(ctx["prepare"]);initial=storage(ctx,"initial")
    a.require(all(not p.exists()and not p.is_symlink()for p in (ctx["output"],ctx["worker"],ctx["transport"])),
      "Loaded destinations already exist")
    ctx["output"].mkdir(parents=True)
    result=initial_result(ctx,reservations,initial);primary=None;supervisor=None;heartbeat=None;previous={};prepared=None
    try:
        a.write(ctx["output"]/"result.json",result)
        if not ctx["prepare"]:
            prepared,proof=fetch_preparation(ctx);result["same_run_preparation"]=proof
        supervisor=runtime.supervisor(ROOT,ctx["output"],ctx["output"]/"supervision",a.methods,
          method["protected_sha256"][runtime.SAMPLER])
        supervisor.TRACE.mkdir()
        for sig in (signal.SIGINT,signal.SIGTERM):previous[sig]=signal.signal(sig,supervisor.interrupted)
        candidate=threading.Thread(target=supervisor.heartbeat,daemon=True);candidate.start();heartbeat=candidate
        execute(ctx,result,supervisor)
    except BaseException as error:
        primary=error;result.update(status="FAIL_OR_REJECTED_CURRENT_TAIL_LOADED_CASE",
          body_error=error_record("loaded_worker",error))
    terminal_errors=finalize(ctx,result,supervisor,heartbeat,previous,prepared)
    publication_error=None
    try:publish(ctx,result)
    except BaseException as error:publication_error=error
    if primary is not None:raise primary
    if terminal_errors:raise terminal_errors[0]
    if publication_error is not None:raise publication_error
    a.require(result["status"]==(PREP_PASS if ctx["prepare"]else CASE_PASS),"Original loaded case did not qualify")
    return result

    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument("--case",choices=a.CASES,required=True)
